hypothesis_title: ML-driven Multi-Asset KR ETF Rotation — 30% cash residual 직교 alpha source (long-only + ETF only + ML)
hypothesis_description: 도훈 명시 (2026-05-04): WT-008 KR 10년 국채 정석 답이라 비정석 후보 재요청. 추가 제약: long-only / 선물 X / ETF 풀만 / ML 가능. 핵심 통찰: KR ETF 정적 비중은 cor 높거나 cost 큼 → ML이 직교성의 source. ML이 regime + timing 결정으로 rotation decision 자체가 STR_1715 alpha와 다른 정보 set. Universe: 9 KR ETFs (KODEX 200 broad equity + KODEX 국고채10년 + TIGER 미국S&P + KODEX 골드 hedged + KODEX 미국채10년 hedged + KODEX 200미국채혼합 multi-asset + KODEX 한국부동산리츠 + KODEX 200 저변동성 + TIGER 단기통안채). Model: XGBoost or LSTM regime classifier with cor penalty. AX-007 exception path 'ML sizing' 자동 활용. 학술 anchor: Gu-Kelly-Xiu (2020 RFS) empirical asset pricing via ML / Avramov-Cheng-Metzker (2021 RAS) ML asset pricing / Andrew Lo (2004) adaptive markets / Moody-Saffell (2001 RFS) reinforcement learning trading.

method_specification.research_question: 30% cash residual을 ML-driven KR ETF rotation으로 대체할 때 직교성 (cor < 0.30) + crisis hedge + Harvey t_NW > 3.0 + DSR PASS (multiple testing) 모두 충족 가능한가?

ml_architecture.primary_model: XGBoost regime classifier + factor timing predictor
input_features: macro: FRED VIX, US 10y, USD/KRW, oil, copper
kr_market: KOSPI200 returns, VKOSPI level, KOSPI volume, KRW yield curve
regime: M4 schedule weight + AR_t value (information from STR_1715 base)
ml_architecture.training_loss: weighted = forecast_accuracy_loss + lambda * cor_penalty(rotation_return, STR_1715_AR_M4) + mu * vol_penalty
ml_architecture.ml_validation: walk-forward expanding window, no full-sample fitting (PIT C1)

evaluation_axis.crisis_behavior: GFC + COVID + Stagflation rotation positive return OR KOSPI200 outperform
evaluation_axis.kr_availability: 9 ETF tickers existence + AUM > 100B KRW + tracking error < 30bps
evaluation_axis.ml_robustness: OOS Sharpe > 0.5, walk-forward stable across 3+ sub-periods
evaluation_axis.harvey_t_nw: regression of rotation_return on STR_1715 + macro factors, t_NW > 3.0
evaluation_axis.dsr_pass: Bailey-Lopez de Prado DSR > 0 + p < 0.05 (n=8 trials in cycle)

user_constraints_explicit.cross_market_allowed: for ETF pool inclusion (USD equity hedged ETF traded on KR exchange)

primary_objective.alpha_preservation: STR_1715 + AR overlay 무손상 mandate 유지

decision_rule.PASS: 직교성 cor < 0.30 + Harvey t_NW > 3.0 + DSR PASS + crisis hedge + KR 가용 + cost < 50bps + ML walk-forward stable
decision_rule.CONDITIONAL_PASS: 5/7 axis PASS + 2 marginal flagged for monitoring
decision_rule.FAIL: 직교성 위반 OR Harvey FAIL OR DSR FAIL OR ML overfit detected

axiom_constraints.AX-002: PIT enforced + research_only no book_state write

state_machine_path.expected: SPEC_APPROVED → ALPHA_DONE → RISK_DONE → OPTIMIZER_DONE → FORGE_DONE → JUDGE_PASSED → GOVERNOR_REJECTED → ABORTED
